slides.title: Welcome
slides.text: Good evening, everyone. Today I will introduce the Lantern Cove community garden project.
slides.speaker: Speaker A

slides.title: Why
slides.text: Many neighbors told us they want a quiet place to grow vegetables and meet each other.
slides.speaker: Speaker A

slides.title: Where
slides.text: The garden will use an empty lot beside the old bus stop, about four hundred square meters.
slides.speaker: Speaker A

slides.title: Supplement (hidden)
slides.text: This hidden slide holds the soil test table.

slides.title: Plots
slides.text: We plan thirty small plots, each rented for one season at a low price.
slides.speaker: Speaker B

slides.title: Schedule
slides.text: Building starts in March, and the first planting day is in late April.
slides.speaker: Speaker B

slides.title: Budget
slides.text: The total cost is about five thousand dollars, mostly for soil, fences, and tools.
slides.speaker: Speaker B

slides.title: Thank you
slides.text: Thank you for listening. Please tell us your questions and ideas.
slides.speaker: Speaker A
